mapper.insert: SELECT studytag_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO studytag ( tag_num, tag_name, tag_color ) VALUES (#{tag_num}, #{tag_name}, #{tag_color} )
mapper.select: SELECT tag_num, tag_name, tag_color FROM studytag WHERE LOWER(tag_name) = LOWER(#{tag_name})
SELECT is_leader FROM group_member WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND group_num = #{group_num}
